quarterly_data.quarter: Samsung Electro-Mechanics IR presentation: Q2 2026 results (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results deck, Package Solution: sales KRW 771.6B (+6% QoQ, +37% YoY); FCBGA revenue increased around AI / server / automotive substrates, with increased supply of high-end AI accelerator and server CPU substrates for major Big Tech customers, full-scale supply of a new product for a new customer's AI data center network application, and more ADAS / autonomous-driving substrates; BGA grew on mobile AP and memory substrates. Q3 outlook: revenue growth expected with mass production of new AI accelerator / server CPU substrates for global Big Tech customers; demand for high-end data-center FCBGA remains strong, and the company is increasing capacity and high-end substrate supply.

players.product: High-cap automotive/industrial-grade MLCCs (CL/CG series) for AI PDN decoupling

quarterly_data.quarter: Samsung Electro-Mechanics IR presentation: Q2 2026 results (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results deck, Component: sales KRW 1,649.4B (+17% QoQ, +29% YoY), capacitors 92% of division sales; revenue rose across all applications, with strong growth in data-center applications including AI server, network and power, and higher automotive revenue on ADAS and xEV demand; the company is actively responding to multiple global big tech customers' long-term supply requests. Q3 outlook: demand for high-capacitance / high-reliability MLCC to keep growing on ongoing AI infrastructure investment and AI semiconductor performance gains.
